name: Enhance
base_effect: Enhance Brawn-based checks. Spend pips to add successes.
narrative_capability: Can channel the Force through physical action — enhanced jumps, bursts of speed, feats of strength beyond normal capability.
gm_choice_guidance: Offer Force-enhanced physical choices when the character could augment their body with the Force. Enhanced leaps, preternatural speed, impossible feats of strength. Enhance functions primarily as a Force-enhanced skill check rather than pure Force action. Tag as [Force:Enhance] when the physical action is clearly augmented.
dark_side_flavor: Dark side Enhance is raw. Not augmentation but override — the body pushed past its limits by something that doesn't care about limits. Muscles tear, joints pop, and the pain is distant because the dark side doesn't acknowledge it.

commitment_option.effect: Ongoing physical augmentation. Add +1 to Brawn for checks while committed.
commitment_option.narrative_note: The Force sustains a constant physical enhancement — every motion a fraction stronger, a fraction faster than the body alone could manage.

control_sustained_brawn.name: Control: Sustained Brawn
control_sustained_brawn.effect: Commit 1 Force die. Add +1 to Brawn characteristic for skill checks while committed.
control_sustained_brawn.narrative: Not a burst of power but a constant presence. The Force flows through muscle and bone continuously, a quiet strength that doesn't fade.

control_sustained_agility.name: Control: Sustained Agility
control_sustained_agility.effect: Commit 1 Force die. Add +1 to Agility characteristic for skill checks while committed.
control_sustained_agility.narrative: Speed and precision sharpen. Reactions quicken. The body moves before conscious thought directs it — the Force fills the gap between intent and execution.

control_leap.name: Control: Force Leap
control_leap.effect: Can perform Force-enhanced leaps, clearing horizontal or vertical distances far beyond normal capability.
control_leap.narrative: The jump is wrong — too far, too high, held at the apex too long. The Force doesn't cancel gravity. It just makes gravity irrelevant for a moment.

strength_1.name: Strength
strength_1.effect: Add additional successes to Force-enhanced physical checks.
strength_1.narrative: The augmentation deepens. What was assistance becomes dominance — the Force doesn't help the body, it carries it.
